S.M.P. Headquarters.
May 29, 1940.

Headquarters Circular No.154.

Chinese Clerical Staff.

As a result of a thorough survey of the Chinese
Clerical Staff an established strength was laid down for
all offices and stations in 1939, and a gradation list
compiled.

A copy of both is attached and will form the
basis of all promotions and transfers in the future in
the same manner as the executive staff.

(1) Promotions from third to second grade Clerks
will be subject to the passing of a qualifying examination
which will be held in April and October each year by
D.C.(Chinese). The results of such examination will be
noted in orders.

(2) Promotions will be by selection in accordance
with the vacancies existing in the established strength. A
Promotion Board of D.C.(Chinese), A.C.(Chinese) and Chinese
Superintendents will sit in June and December each year when
all vacancies then existing will be filled.

(3) With the exception of such specialist posts
as Finger Print Bureau Clerks and Recording Office Steno-
typists, promotions will not necessarily be confined to
men in the Offices or Stations wherein the vacancies exist.
It will therefore be necessary for transfers to be made
from time to time but a period necessary for handing over
will be permitted.

(4) D.C.(Chinese) will proceed immediately with
the necessary transfers in order to bring the various
staffs to established strength.

(5) It is not the intention to dismiss or reduce
in rank any Clerk now shown extra to establishment, but the
established strength of each office or station will be
arrived at gradually and in the shortest time possible over
a number of years.

上海公共租界工部局警务处总部。
1940年5月29日。

总部通令第154号。

华员文书职员。

鉴于对华员文书职员进行了全面调查，于1939年为所有办公室及巡捕房核定了编制人数，并编制了等级名单。

两份文件副本附后，将作为今后所有晋升和调动的依据，其方式与行动组职员相同。

(1) 三等文员晋升为二等文员，须通过由华务副总巡（D.C.(Chinese)）每年四月和十月举行的资格考试。考试结果将在命令中注明。

(2) 晋升将根据核定编制中现有的空缺情况进行选拔。由华务副总巡（D.C.(Chinese)）、华务助理副总巡（A.C.(Chinese)）及华人督察组成的晋升委员会将于每年六月和十二月召开会议，届时将填补所有现有空缺。

(3) 除指纹局文员和记录室速记打字员等专门职位外，晋升不一定局限于存在空缺的办公室或巡捕房内的职员。因此，有必要不时进行调动，但会允许必要的交接时间。

(4) 华务副总巡（D.C.(Chinese)）将立即进行必要的调动，以使各处职员达到核定编制人数。

(5) 目前无意解雇或降低任何超编文员的职级，但各办公室或巡捕房的核定编制人数将在数年内逐步并在尽可能短的时间内达成。

Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE.
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, APR 3 1935

Sir :

The permanent establishment of Foreigners in the Special Branch is 17.
On April 1st, the actual strength was 18, but since then Mr. Ross and Macadie have gone on leave, so our present strength is only 16, understrength by one.

Returned.
Thanks.
M.
Please return attached table to me to keep
J Byas

备忘录。
警务处。
工部局。
上海，1935年4月3日

先生：

特别支部外籍人员的正式编制为17人。
4月1日，实际在岗人数为18人，但此后罗斯（Ross）先生和麦卡迪（Macadie）已休假，故目前我方在岗人数仅为16人，缺编一人。

退回。
谢谢。
M.
请将附表退还给我留存
J·拜亚斯（J Byas）
